provenance.label_method: regex weak labels, rule set v2 with qualified patterns (see label_config.json)

hyperparameters.encoder_fallback_reason: Internet is OFF and no local copy of the encoder was found

ood_guard.method: cosine similarity to nearest training case, 5th percentile of held-out texts

note_on_metrics: Test metrics come from the model fitted on the train split only; the saved model is re-fitted on all rows.
limitations: Labels are rule-derived weak labels, not human annotations; metrics measure agreement with the rules.
Training text is post-mortem narratives of failed startups; user input is forward-looking, so a domain shift exists.
All training rows are failures: the model cannot estimate whether a startup will fail.
Outputs are predicted risk themes, not confirmed causes.
Regulatory, macro and acquisition-driven failures are outside the 8-category taxonomy.
Probabilities are calibrated against weak labels on out-of-fold data; small categories give noisy calibration.
The weak-label rules have NOT been audited by a human: rule precision is unknown, so test metrics only show agreement with the rules.

The offline fallback encoder (TF-IDF + SVD) was used because the sentence encoder could not be loaded; it captures wording rather than meaning, so re-run with Internet ON or the MiniLM model attached for better generalisation.
